correctness.rationale: The complex is the OPEN Lovász neighborhood complex, not the clique or closed-neighborhood complex. Subsets of each of the 27 six-element open neighborhoods give f=(27,243,540,405,162,27), 1404 nonempty faces. Elementary collapses remove 486 free-face pairs, leaving a 2-dimensional complex. A spanning tree on 27 vertices removes 26 edge gauges; the exact triangle cocycle equations have three-dimensional H1, and Euler characteristic 54 forces H2 dimension 56 and no higher reduced homology. The degree-one W=S3 wreath S3 action is the signed coordinate permutation representation. An independent enumeration of all 1296 permutations, all 1404 faces and signed simplicial Lefschetz traces gave all 22 conjugacy-class trace pairs exactly, including H2 identity 56 and transposition-type -18. Nontrivial ternary translations have H2 trace2; thus restriction H2 to A=(Z/3)^3 is 2 Q[A] plus 2 trivials. Character averaging gives translation invariants 4 and full W invariants 0. This is finite exact representation theory, not inference from test logs.
